narrative.overview: Aether is set the way a printed proof is set, not built the way a dashboard is built. Paper divided by hairlines; the formal layer in one monospace; the intern's prose the only break in the grid. Failure is the event: a failing step gets a 2px rail in the margin, and so does everything that rests on it.
keyCharacteristics: Paper and ink, hairline rules, near-square corners (2px).
One monospace family for everything formal; system sans only for the intern's sentences.
Status lives in 2px rails and coloured words, never in filled pills or cards.
Green appears only in the verdict, so red lands when it does.
Light and dark are equal citizens, each with its own picked palette.

rules.name: The Green Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Green appears in the verdict and nowhere else; a passing step's status is set in dim ink.

rules.name: The Two Schemes Rule
rules.body: Syntax colour has a mono default and a vivid opt-in over one token vocabulary.

rules.name: The Formal-Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything the engine checks is set in the monospace; only the intern's sentences use the sans.

rules.name: The No Boxes Rule
rules.body: Organise with hairlines and alignment; a box is reserved for callouts that carry a failure.

dos: Do let a failing step's 2px rail and red word carry the page; keep everything that verified quiet.
Do set every checked artefact in JetBrains Mono and every explanatory sentence in the system sans.
Do separate regions with 1px Rule/Hairline lines and tonal surfaces, not containers.
Do define colour once in the --wa-* token layer and alias it; light and dark each get picked values.
Do keep corners at 2px and status rails at 2px.
donts: Don't use green anywhere but the verdict.
Don't wrap rows in cards, give passing steps badges, or use filled status pills.
Don't introduce a display face, italics, or a second sans.
Don't add drop shadows; depth is tonal, and the selected-row inset ring is the only shadow.
Don't fetch anything cross-origin (icons, fonts, scripts): the app makes no runtime network requests.
